title: Mall world can be heaven or hell…

classification.theory_summary: Mall World valence (heaven/hell) depends on the dreamer's fear vs. positive mindset; lucidity/"ok I'm dreaming" allows shifting to more positive areas.
classification.skip_reason: No specific dream episode, locations, sequences, or sensory/spatial details described; primarily advice/theory about changing dream tone.

meta.author_theory: Mall World is an "altered consciousness" space; fear/resistance makes it scarier; positive energy and lucidity ("ok I'm dreaming") can shift to more positive parts; some people feel trapped in scary Mall World due to fear.

extraction.extraction_notes: Phenomenological content is limited to general affective stance toward Mall World (familiar, interesting, not scared) and claims about shifting to "other parts" when lucid; no describable place-features (light, layout, entities, boundaries) are provided.
